grounding.observation: Existing335 scope includes supporting-cast finish; current motion rejection is explicitly retained.
grounding.comparison: Read-only asset ownership work is independent of another motion correction.

expert_coverage.observation: Inventory covers actual garment topology, parents, shape-key caches and assigned material graphs.
expert_coverage.comparison: Source-code intent is insufficient when visible clothing may use different materials or baked deformation.

film_alignment.observation: Observed accepted Pashtun image remains a bound unchanged quality comparator.
film_alignment.comparison: Inventory cannot qualify schematic cast appearance or lower the film floor.

preferences.observation: Continue independent authorized work, without requiring another routine technical approval.
preferences.comparison: The separate motion allowance question remains unresolved and is not bypassed.

reference_roles.observation: Faithful rearing reference remains an interface constraint for later appearance merge.
reference_roles.comparison: No motion or literal human identity copying is claimed from this inventory.

method.observation: Fixed trusted read-only handler inspects leader and nearest crowd actor; no arbitrary targets or code inputs.
method.comparison: Compact actual graph data can discriminate wrong assignment from inadequate shader/mesh design.

interfaces.observation: Inventory records cached poses and parent transforms before mesh/material changes.
interfaces.comparison: No assumption that adding folds to a rest mesh preserves animated clothing.

efficient_quality.observation: One read-only source inspection, no render or whole-trailer rebuild.
efficient_quality.comparison: No claimed efficiency percentage or artistic qualification.

authority.observation: Local read-only existing-source operation with zero correction allowance.
authority.comparison: No resumption/reset of failed motion, new asset, install, provider or egress.

strongest_counterexample: A detailed inventory can still encourage texture-only patching when the silhouette and garment construction are wrong. The next appearance strategy must compare actual forms at intended framing and fix structure before surface detail; this report does not approve such a strategy.
